svg.aria-label: truffle architecture: seven layers on each device, joined by the tailnet
svg.title: truffle architecture: seven layers on each device, joined by the tailnet
svg.desc: Two identical stacks, alice-laptop and bob-phone. From the top: your app, the Node API, Envelope (L6), Session (L5), Transport (L4), Network (L3) and the Go sidecar that embeds tsnet. Each layer is labelled with what it handles. Underneath both, Tailscale carries the bytes: WireGuard tunnels, identity, access rules and NAT traversal.
